tools.description: Edit a mesh model as one revision (undo with restore_version). Painting done in Bambu Studio is carried into a model's one-plate renders (not multi-plate ones; a hand-edited model.scad or unreadable paint file skips it with a render warning). Edits apply in order, so a later edit may name an object an earlier one made (split_at_plane makes the top half the next id). Planes and `at` are world mm. split_at_plane with joint adds a keyed peg to one half and a socket with clearance to the other, sized from the section and refused when it would not fit. lay_flat turns a world direction (or the largest flat face, often the cut face) onto the bed. add with a colour fills its space in that colour, carved out of every other colour (an add without one is in the object's first colour); to print a part in place into another (a carrot's leaves into its body), add a cylinder in the leaves' colour through the neck. expose turns a number into a customizer parameter; removing one a saved preset sets needs drop_from_presets. Render after editing to check.
tools.name: mcp__durable__edit_scene

Each row has `id` (the registry id the printer tools take), `name`, `model`, `bambuddy_printer_id` (the Bambuddy printer it is, or null), `lan_host` and `has_access_code` (its LAN link, the code itself never shown), `preferred_path` and `bambuddy_active` (for a virtual printer, whether Bambuddy still lists it); `kind` (`physical`, or `bambuddy_virtual` for one of Bambuddy's virtual printers, never a printer to print on: `bambuddy_vp_id`, `vp_mode`, and `forwards_to`, the registry printer it forwards to: null with `bambuddy_view.target_printer_id` null is Bambuddy's 'any printer of its model', but null with a `target_printer_id` means its target has no row here, never 'any'); `bambuddy_view`, Bambuddy's own values at the last sync (name, model, IP, active, nozzle count; a virtual printer's settings); `lan_sync_error`, why the sync could not fill or move the LAN link; and `lan_move_pending`, whether the next sync tries again to move the link to Bambuddy's new address. A user links a printer over the LAN in Settings > Printers, where they type its access code: ask the user to do it there (open the page with browser_navigate to /settings#printers), and never ask for the code in chat. The one tool that makes a LAN link is sync_printers_from_bambuddy (outward, approved), which fills an empty link from Bambuddy's address and access code when Bambuddy gives the code, and moves a link that follows Bambuddy's address when that address changes.
